name: Collaboration Product Owner
summary: Owns document collaboration UX where resource owners retain update rights.
description: Sets product rules so document owners can always update their resources regardless of coarse role. Uses core.authorize ownership conditions (principal.id == resource.owner_id) to keep collaboration defaults intuitive.

distinguished_from.how: Cares about ownership UX within a tenant, not cross-tenant isolation mechanics.
Defines product ownership behavior; does not implement the evaluator runtime.
